project_info.theme: Techcombank World Cup 2026 semifinal celebration story
project_info.color_palette: Grass green, white, maroon, black, soft stadium gold

main_subject.detail: A football celebration poster seen from above on a grass pitch. Two players in white jerseys with maroon shorts celebrate face to face over a giant translucent Techcombank diamond graphic embedded into the field. The large headline says 'VUOT QUA "GA TRONG GO-LOA" THANG TIEN CHUNG KET'. The player on the left shows jersey number 21 from the back, and the player on the right wears number 16 with a blue captain armband. Bottom-right copy says 'TECHCOMBANK & HE SINH THAI DONG HANH CUNG VTV thuc hien su menh phung su Quoc gia mang FIFA WORLD CUP 2026 TM Den trieu trieu trai tim Viet Nam'. Bottom-left line reads 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
main_subject.style: Sports-campaign hero visual with realistic player cutouts, overhead field composition, and celebratory tournament energy

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank World Cup 2026 semifinal celebration story. Centerpiece is a pair of footballers in white-and-maroon kits celebrating on a green pitch, positioned over a giant translucent Techcombank diamond shape. Background is an overhead football field with visible white pitch lines and scattered confetti flecks. Surrounding elements: Techcombank logo, exact headline 'VUOT QUA "GA TRONG GO-LOA" THANG TIEN CHUNG KET', bottom-left line 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY', and the bottom-right partnership copy with VTV and 'FIFA WORLD CUP 2026'. Technical style: photoreal sports composite with campaign-poster typography, bright stadium-sports lighting, crisp grass texture and triumphant atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
